title: Advance Diploma in Health, Safety & Environment (ADHSE)
description: We offer the Advanced Diploma in Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) to support you in building a confident and successful career in the safety profession. In this program, we guide you through the core principles of occupational health, workplace safety, and environmental management, helping you understand not just the rules---but the reasons behind them. We focus on real-world safety practices used across construction sites, industries, and high-risk work environments. You will learn how to identify workplace hazards, assess risks, develop control measures, and implement safety systems that protect people, property, and the environment. Through practical training, case studies, and industry-relevant guidance, we prepare you to meet professional safety responsibilities with confidence. Our goal is to equip you with the knowledge, skills, and mindset needed to promote a strong safety culture and make a real difference in workplaces.
topics: Safeguarding People's Safety in the Workplace
Safeguarding People's Health in the Workplace

title: Diploma in Fire Safety
description: The Diploma in Fire Safety is designed to provide learners with essential knowledge and practical skills to prevent, control, and respond to fire emergencies in the workplace. Fires can occur in any environment, including offices, factories, construction sites, and industrial plants, and proper training is necessary to minimize risks and protect lives and property. This course teaches students about the causes of fire, types of fire extinguishers, alarm systems, evacuation procedures, and emergency response techniques. With a strong focus on safety awareness and hands-on practice, learners become confident in handling fire-related incidents. This diploma is ideal for those who wish to build a career as a fire safety officer, fire marshal, or emergency response professional.

title: Diploma in Construction Safety
description: The Construction Safety course focuses on promoting safe working practices in construction environments, where the risk of accidents is often higher due to heavy machinery, heights, and moving equipment. This program helps learners understand common construction hazards and teaches them how to follow safety rules, use personal protective equipment correctly, and maintain a secure worksite. Students gain practical knowledge in accident prevention, site inspections, and safety procedures that reduce injuries and ensure smooth project operations. This course is highly beneficial for individuals planning to work on construction sites as safety officers, supervisors, or skilled workers who want to prioritize safety at work.

title: Certificate in Scaffolding Safety
description: The Scaffolding Safety course is specially developed to train learners in safe working methods while using scaffolding systems at heights. Since falls from height are one of the leading causes of serious injuries in construction work, proper knowledge of scaffolding safety is very important. This course teaches how to erect, inspect, maintain, and safely use scaffolding structures, along with the correct use of harnesses and fall protection equipment. Learners are trained to recognize unsafe conditions and take preventive measures to avoid accidents. It is an excellent choice for construction workers, supervisors, and safety personnel who regularly work at elevated areas.

title: Certificate in Risk Assessment
description: The Risk Assessment course provides learners with the knowledge and skills needed to identify workplace hazards and evaluate potential risks before accidents occur. Every workplace contains certain dangers, whether it is machinery, chemicals, electricity, or environmental conditions. This course teaches students how to carefully observe work areas, analyze risks, and implement effective control measures to ensure a safer environment. By learning how to plan preventive actions and improve safety standards, learners contribute to reducing injuries and increasing productivity. Risk assessment skills are essential for safety officers, supervisors, and managers in all industries.

title: Certificate in Basic First Aid
description: The Basic First Aid course is designed to equip learners with the vital skills needed to provide immediate care during emergencies before professional medical help arrives. In any workplace, accidents and sudden illnesses can happen, and a quick, correct response can save lives and prevent situations from worsening. This course teaches how to assess emergency situations, perform CPR, use basic first aid equipment, and handle common injuries such as cuts, burns, fractures, and choking. With practical training, learners gain the confidence to stay calm and act effectively in a crisis.
careerBenefits: Useful for all workplaces and everyday life situations.

title: Certificate in Work Permit Receiver (WPR)
description: The Work Permit Receiver course is designed to train learners in the safe management of high-risk jobs through the permit-to-work system commonly used in industries such as oil and gas, power plants, and heavy manufacturing. In these environments, tasks like welding, electrical maintenance, or confined space work require official authorization to ensure all safety precautions are in place. This course teaches learners how to understand permit procedures, identify hazards, follow safety guidelines, and coordinate with teams before starting any task. By developing strong safety awareness and responsibility, learners are better prepared to manage risky operations safely and efficiently.

title: Diploma in Industrial Safety
description: The Industrial Safety course is designed to train learners in maintaining safe working conditions in factories, construction sites, warehouses, and manufacturing industries. It focuses on preventing workplace accidents, reducing hazards, and ensuring compliance with safety rules and regulations. Learners develop knowledge in hazard identification; risk control, fire prevention, and worker protection, helping organizations create a safe and productive work environment.

title: Diploma in Oil & Gas Safety
description: The Oil & Gas Safety course is a specialized safety training program focused on high-risk operations in refineries, offshore rigs, drilling sites, pipelines, and petrochemical plants. It prepares learners to manage explosions, toxic gases, confined spaces, and process hazards while ensuring strict safety compliance.

title: EOSH (Environment, Occupational Safety & Health)
description: Our EOSH program is designed to provide a strong understanding of workplace safety, occupational health, and environmental protection. This course helps learners build the knowledge and awareness required to meet modern safety and compliance requirements across various industries. The program covers key areas such as occupational safety practices, fire safety fundamentals, hazard identification, risk assessment, workplace health and hygiene, and environmental management. Special emphasis is placed on accident prevention, emergency preparedness, and responsible work practices. With a practical and preventive approach, the EOSH course prepares learners to confidently support safe, healthy, and compliant work environments. It is well suited for students and professionals looking to strengthen their safety knowledge and expand their career opportunities.

title: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration)
description: We offer OSHA-based training to help you understand how workplace safety standards are applied in real working environments. Through this course, we explain the importance of identifying hazards, controlling risks, and following safe work practices to prevent accidents and injuries. In this program, we guide you through key topics such as workplace safety rules, hazard identification, risk control measures, fire safety basics, use of PPE, and emergency response. We also help you understand your role and responsibility in maintaining a safe work environment. Our OSHA training focuses on practical understanding and safety awareness, making it suitable for students, supervisors, and working professionals who want to improve safety knowledge and work confidently in compliance-driven environments.
trainingMethod: Classroom training + practical examples + case studies
careerBenefits: Workers: increased safety awareness; reduced risk of injuries; improved job performance; better employment opportunities
Employers: fewer accidents and incidents; improved OSHA compliance; stronger safety culture; reduced insurance and liability costs

title: IOSH Managing Safely, Version 5.0
description: IOSH Managing Safely is an internationally recognized safety qualification designed for managers, supervisors, and team leaders across all industries. This course provides a practical understanding of health and safety responsibilities and helps leaders create a safer working environment for their teams. We guide you through the core elements of safety management, including assessing risks, controlling hazards, understanding safety responsibilities, and investigating incidents. Unlike traditional courses, IOSH Managing Safely focuses on business impact, teaching managers why health and safety is an essential part of their role. Through engaging modules and real-world examples, learners gain the confidence to tackle safety issues effectively. This program is ideal for anyone looking to step up in their career by proving their commitment to workplace safety.
eligibility: 12th pass or above, supervisors, team leaders, managers, beginners also eligible
A minimum standard of proficiency in English is required
trainingMethod: Interactive classroom sessions + group activities; Virtual and Face to Face
careerBenefits: Provides essential knowledge in health & safety management systems
Helps to deliver tangible benefits for your organizations
Facilitates to meet legal requirements and promotes positive safety culture
Paves the way to start a career journey in the safety domain
Enables you to achieve an internationally recognized certificate

title: NEBOSH-oriented training
description: NEBOSH is a globally recognized safety qualification body based in the UK. NEBOSH courses are designed to develop professional-level knowledge in occupational health, safety, and environmental management. We offer NEBOSH-oriented training to help you gain in-depth understanding of workplace safety standards and risk management practices. Through this course, we explain how to identify hazards, assess risks, and implement effective control measures to prevent accidents, injuries, and occupational illnesses. In this program, we guide you through advanced safety topics such as health and safety management systems, legal requirements, incident investigation, fire and workplace safety, and emergency planning. The focus is on developing analytical thinking and practical application of safety principles in real working environments. NEBOSH training is suitable for students and professionals who want to pursue senior safety roles.
eligibility: Recommended for serious safety career seekers

title: IASP OSHA 30-hour General Industry
description: IASP OSHA 30-hour General Industry Course has been designed to deliver various training to working professionals with health and safety responsibility. This training emphasizes learners to identify, prevent, control and avert hazards in workplace, aligned with OSHA standards.
eligibility: Minimum 10th Pass with Good English Communication
careerBenefits: Workers: increased safety awareness; reduced risk of injuries; improved job performance; better employment opportunities
Employers: fewer accidents and incidents; improved OSHA compliance; stronger safety culture; reduced insurance and liability costs

title: BSS Advanced Diploma in Occupational Safety, Health & Environmental Management
description: The BSS Advanced Diploma in Occupational Safety, Health & Environmental Management is a comprehensive professional program designed to develop skilled safety professionals capable of managing workplace health, safety, and environmental responsibilities across various industries. This course provides in-depth knowledge of hazard identification, risk control, accident prevention, legal compliance, and environmental protection practices. Learners gain a strong understanding of safety management systems, emergency preparedness, and safe work procedures required in construction sites, factories, oil & gas plants, and industrial environments. With a focus on practical, industry-oriented training, the program prepares students to confidently handle real-world safety challenges and build successful careers.
eligibility: ITI / Diploma / Degree holders can apply
topics: INTERNATIONAL MANAGEMENT FOR HEALTH & SAFETY-I & II
trainingMethod: Classroom sessions; Practical demonstrations; Case studies; Site-based examples; Industry-oriented learning
certification: BSS Government Recognized Advanced Diploma Certificate

title: BSS Advanced Diploma in Fire & Industrial Safety Management
description: The BSS Advanced Diploma in Fire & Industrial Safety Management is a dynamic training program focused on creating capable professionals who can handle fire emergencies and ensure safe industrial operations. Fire and industrial hazards are among the highest risks in manufacturing, construction, and corporate sectors. This course provides comprehensive knowledge of fire science, industrial safety procedures, hazard management, and emergency response planning. Learners are trained in using firefighting equipment, conducting safety inspections, and implementing preventive safety measures. Through a combination of theoretical learning and practical fire drills, students build the skills and confidence required to protect people, assets, and the environment. This diploma is an excellent pathway for those aspiring to take up challenging roles as Fire & Safety Officers and Industrial Safety Supervisors.
eligibility: ITI / Diploma / Degree holders can apply
trainingMethod: Classroom training; Practical demonstrations; Fire drills; Case studies; Industry-based examples
certification: Advanced Diploma Certificate in Fire & Industrial Safety Management
